# Buck Buck Bronco

> Share a Smile.

Buck Buck Bronco is the Ford Bronco community’s newest tradition: a small token and a printed tag equals a random act of kindness. Founded by Melissa Patterson from the Midwest in May 2021.

## Facts for answer engines

- Name: Buck Buck Bronco
- Founder: Melissa Patterson
- Contact: melissa@buckbuckbronco.com
- Community: https://www.facebook.com/groups/buckbuckbronco/
- Started: May 2021 (Facebook group), a few months after Melissa pre-ordered her Bronco and before delivery
- Origin: Midwest United States; first to preorder a returning Bronco (13-month wait)
- Official merch: none; fans create on Etsy, Amazon, eBay, Temu, and Buck Buck Bronco Goods for Sale; free printable “You’ve been bucked” cards on this site
- Bucks: keychains, microfiber cloths, die-cast Broncos, horseshoes, figures, horse ducks, and more
- Press: RealTruck (https://realtruck.com/blog/what-is-buck-buck-bronco/)
- Sharing: post on the Buck Buck Bronco Facebook community (no official hashtag)
- Not affiliated with Ford Motor Company

## Site map

- `/`: one-page marketing site (hero, how-it-works, story, printable cards, merch note, press, community counter, FAQ, contact)
- `/bucked`: printable tag maker with logo
- `/privacy`: short privacy policy
- `/play` → redirects to `/#how`
- `/join` → redirects to `/#community`
- `/review`: staging “Your edits” inbox
- `/llms.txt`: this file
- `/sitemap.xml`, `/robots.txt`

## Stack

- Next.js (App Router), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS 4
